result.question: Why did Uzziah dig many cisterns?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain | dug many cisterns

assessments.reason: The passage states, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain… [he] dug many cisterns,” matching the causal reason given in the answer.

result.reason: Verse 26:10 explicitly links Uzziah’s many cisterns to his having much livestock in the foothills and the plain.
